newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian C.bank cuts key refinancing rate again.
newsitem.headline: Latvian C.bank cuts key refinancing rate again.

text.p: The Latvian central bank said on Thursday that it has cut its key refinancing rate to nine percent from 9.5 percent.
The last rate cut was in December last year, when it was reduced to 9.5 percent from 10 percent.
The refinancing rate is a key reference rate in the Latvian money market and it is the minimum rate at which the banks can obtain two-week funds from the central bank.
The bank said in a statement that inflation figures were better than forecast and the government budget has been fulfilled succesfully.
It also said that an increase in economic activity and the stable performance of the financial system were behind the cut.
"By reducing its operational rates, the central bank of Latvia supports an overall reduction of interest rates and consequently faster econpmic growth," the bank added.
The finance ministry said late last year the budget deficit was well within the year-end target of 40 million lats.
